text: I'm his older sister, I'm 17 and our parents are out so I need a straight answer. My brother is 7, temp is 39.7. His breathing is really fast, like way faster than normal, and when I lift his top I can see the skin sucking in under his ribs every time he breathes in. He's also making a grunting sort of noise at the end of each breath. I counted and it's loads more than mine. He's had a temperature since yesterday but the breathing only got like this tonight. I've given him calpol about two hours ago. Do I call an ambulance or drive him in myself? I can drive. Don't need a long explanation just tell me which one.
